text: 照照（dsh-cook-pet）是供 DSH 桌面用户使用的互动桌宠。它通过 DSH 宿主事件识别任务运行、完成和等待用户回应的状态，并在独立 Electron 置顶窗中播放待机、炒菜、端菜、托腮等动画；单击会随机 wink 或转圈，拖动可移动窗口，右键可切换大小。状态与素材由本地 WebServer 路由提供，适合希望在桌面上直观看到 DSH 会话进度并进行轻量互动的用户。需要 DSH WebServer，缺少 Electron 时会自动准备运行时；不需要额外 API 密钥。

Zhaozhao is an interactive desktop pet for DSH. An always-on-top Electron window shows task and waiting animations. Click for a wink or spin, drag to move it, and right-click to change size. It uses local routes for state and assets; Electron is prepared when missing. No API key is required.
想让桌面宠物跟着 DSH 任务状态切换动画。
DSH 正在运行时，有没有置顶小窗显示会话进度？
希望任务成功完成时桌面角色能给个动画提示。
DSH 等我批准权限或回答问题时，能不能提醒我？
I want a small desktop companion that shows when my DSH task is running or waiting for me.
Can a floating pet celebrate when a DSH turn completes successfully?
How can I keep a draggable DSH status widget above my other apps?
照照（dsh-cook-pet）的功能「状态动画」：根据 DSH 回合事件显示待机、炒菜、成功端菜或等待回应动画；回合中断或失败时返回待机。
照照（dsh-cook-pet）的功能「等待提示」：当会话等待权限决定或用户回答时显示托腮状态，等待结束后恢复，并设有超时回退。
照照（dsh-cook-pet）的功能「桌面互动」：单击宠物随机播放 wink 或转圈动画，播放结束后恢复当前状态。
照照（dsh-cook-pet）的功能「窗口控制」：拖动置顶窗可调整位置，右键循环切换窗口大小；位置和尺寸由主进程保存。
Show me when my DSH session is waiting for approval without keeping the app in front.

> 一只住在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) 里的小厨娘桌宠。
> 她叫**照照** —— 没活干时握着锅铲站着晃；你派活给她就**颠锅炒菜**；一轮任务做完，
> 她**端着一盘热菜**来报喜；**需要你批准或回话时，她托着腮歪头等你**；戳一下还会 wink 或转个圈。

**四种状态（动图，就是桌面上的实际动作）：**

| 待机 | 炒菜 | 上菜 | 托腮 |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
|  |  |  |  |
| 站着轻轻晃 | 颠锅翻炒 | 端盘报喜 | 歪头等你 |

---

dsh-cook-pet README · ✨ 她会做什么：| 时机 | 状态 | 画面 | 文字 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 没有任务在跑 | **待机** | 握着锅铲站着轻轻晃 | 无 |
| 回合进行中（`turn/start`） | **炒菜** | 颠锅翻炒 | 无 |
| **等你批准 / 等你回答问题** | **托腮** | 手背抵着下巴歪头看你 | **等你回话** |
| 回合成功完成 | **上菜** | 端着盘子报喜，约 5 秒后自动回待机 | 无 |
| 回合被打断 / 出错 | 静默回待机 | **不庆祝** | 无 |
| 你点她一下 | **wink 或转圈** | 两个里随机挑一个，播完回到当前状态 | 无 |

> **只有「托腮」会显示一行字**，其余全部纯动作。桌宠是装饰性的，平时不该有字挡住画面；
> 只有"轮到你了"这件事值得你一眼看见。
>
> 还有一条刻意的设计：**「上菜」只在任务真的成功时出现**。被打断、出错、超时，
> 她只会安静地回到待机 —— 不会给你一个假的「完成」信号。

dsh-cook-pet README · 🤔 「托腮」到底在等什么：托腮不是模糊的"忙碌"态，它只对应**两类真实等待**：

| 触发 | 对应宿主事件 |
| --- | --- |
| 权限确认弹窗（某个工具要你允许/拒绝） | `approval/asked` → `approval/decided` |
| 模型用 `ask_user_question` 向你提问 | `tool/call` → `tool/result` |
| 计划模式把方案交给你批准（`exit_plan_mode`） | 同上 |
| `run_code` 脚本里发起的提问 | `tool/ptc-dispatch-start` → `tool/ptc-dispatch` |

这些是**成对出现的持久化事件**，所以「开始等你」和「你已答复」都能被精确捕获 ——
不需要轮询、不需要猜，也不会因为弹窗被直接关掉而卡在托腮状态。

dsh-cook-pet README · 🖥️ 桌面置顶窗：Electron 会自动准备好（可选）：「浮在其它应用之上」那个窗口由独立 Electron 进程渲染，需要一份 Electron 运行时
（DSH 宿主本身是纯 Node，不带 Electron 二进制）。

**你不需要做任何事**：首次缺运行时的时候，插件会在**后台自动下载**（约 140 MB，只做一次），
下载完成后桌面窗会自动出现。下载期间 DSH 完全正常，只是还没看到她。

下载本身是**打不死的**：

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 多镜像回退 | npmmirror → registry.npmmirror → huaweicloud，逐个尝试 |
| 有限重试 | 每个镜像 3 次；全部失败才放弃 |
| **断点续传** | 中断/重启后从已下载的字节继续，进度保留在 `~/.dsh/electron/.download/` |
| 停滞超时 | 连续 60 秒无数据主动放弃本次尝试，不会挂死 |

**万一全部失败**，DSH 日志里会打印可照抄的手动安装指引（手动下载 URL、解压目录、
指定已有 Electron、关闭桌面窗四种方式），重启 DSH 后自动续传。

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 她是怎么做出来的：角色与全部 6 段动作都是 **AI 生成**（Q 版日系画风，绿幕/黑底源），
再经一条可复现的素材管线转成带 alpha 的**透明视频**。

| 步骤 | 做法 | 为什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. 取 alpha | 只把「与画面四边连通的纯黑」当背景 | 黑色锅铲、深棕描边不会被误删 |
| 2. 边缘颜色外扩 | 把人物颜色铺满羽化带 | 否则羽化带里的黑底会变成一圈脏黑边 |
| 3. 统一裁切框 | 6 段共用同一框（并集） | 切换动作时人物不会跳位 |
| 4. 编码 | 预乘 alpha → VP9 `yuva420p` | 浏览器唯一可靠的透明视频格式 |

> 最关键的一条：**mp4/H.264 没有 alpha 通道**。所谓"抠图 mp4"只是把背景换成了纯黑或绿幕，
> 透明信息在文件里并不存在 —— 必须重新编码成 `yuva420p` 的 WebM。

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 想换成自己的角色？：**第 0 步（最关键）：生成视频时用绿幕。**

| 背景选择 | 后果 |
| --- | --- |
| **纯绿幕 `#00FF00`** ⭐ | 最好抠：绿与人物色差大，能干净分离；半透明效果（烟雾、光晕）也能保住 |
| 纯黑背景 | 能扣，但**半透明内容会被压平**（白色半透明的烟会变成不透明的深灰），需要额外反推 |
| 白/灰/渐变背景 | 难抠，容易误伤人物浅色部分（白帽子、白围裙） |

另外这几条也要写进生成提示词：**正对镜头固定机位**、**人物不产生位移**、
**首尾帧姿态一致**（循环才不跳帧）、**无文字/水印**。
本项目 6 段素材的完整提示词可直接参考
[docs/视频提示词-等待确认.md](docs/视频提示词-等待确认.md) 与
[docs/视频提示词-点击回应.md](docs/视频提示词-点击回应.md)。

**第 1 步：准备素材文件**

6 段视频按**动作语义**命名，放进 `assets/cook-已抠图/`：

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 想换成自己的角色？：| 文件名 | 什么时候播 | 要求 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `待机.mp4` | 没有任务 | 首尾姿态一致，可循环 |
| `颠锅.mp4` | 回合进行中 | 同上 |
| `上菜.mp4` | 回合成功完成 | 一次性播放 |
| `托腮.mp4` | 等你批准/回答 | 首尾姿态一致，可长时间循环 |
| `wink.mp4` | 点击回应 | 首尾姿态 = 待机姿态 |
| `转圈.mp4` | 点击回应 | 同上 |

> 也可以像本项目最终版那样，直接用**逐帧抠好的 PNG 序列**（真 alpha）替换 ——
> 画质最好，不需要反推。参考 `scripts/build-assets.py` 里的读取分支。

**第 2 步：跑管线并验收**

```bash
npm run assets        # 生成 6 段透明 WebM 到 assets/pet/
npm run assets:check  # 验收：四角透明 / 暗部未误抠 / 6 段尺寸一致 / 颜色通道顺序
```

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 想换成自己的角色？：管线会自动：取 alpha → 边缘颜色外扩 → 统一裁切框 → 编码 VP9 alpha。
控制台会打印每段的尺寸、alpha 覆盖率与四角 alpha。

**第 3 步：只有换了画幅比例时才要改的两处**

| 改了什么 | 还要同步改哪里 |
| --- | --- |
| 裁切框（脚本顶部 `CROP`） | `runtime/electron-helper/renderer.js` 顶部的命中框比例常量 |
| 素材内容变了 | `renderer.js` 里的 `ASSET_VERSION` +1（否则桌面窗可能读到旧缓存） |

**第 4 步：重启 DSH**

桌面窗在启动时就把素材读进内存了，所以换素材后**必须重启**才完全生效。

素材管线踩过的坑（都有数据与回归测试）见 [docs/素材管线实测.md](docs/素材管线实测.md)。

dsh-cook-pet README · 🗂️ 项目结构：```
dsh-cook-pet/
├── 🧩 lib/                      # 宿主侧：跑在 DSH 进程里
│   ├── index.js                 #   入口：监听事件、暴露 /state 与 /asset、拉起桌面窗
│   ├── state.js                 #   四态状态机（idle / cook / serve / think）

**它是怎么跑起来的：**

```
   DSH 宿主进程（lib/index.js）
    ├─ 监听 session/event → lib/state.js（四态）
    ├─ 监听审批/提问     → lib/waiting.js（托腮）
    └─ 暴露 /dsh-cook-pet/state 与 /asset/*

> 没有构建步骤：`lib/*.js` 是手写纯 JS，DSH 直接加载。
> 也没有浏览器内嵌版本 —— 照照只以这个置顶窗存在，最小化 DSH 也能看见她。

dsh-cook-pet README · ⚠️ 已知限制：1. **素材的 alpha 部分是推算的**：源视频没有 alpha，4 段靠"从黑底/绿幕反推"得到；
   颠锅与上菜已换成逐帧抠图的 PNG 序列（真 alpha），边缘更准。
2. **上菜素材是 30fps 但删过 5 帧**（4.73s → 4.57s），理论上可能有一帧级的细微跳变。
3. **换素材要重启一次**：`?v=` 版本号能绕过缓存，但桌面窗启动时就把素材读进内存了。
4. **点击回应是随机二选一**，不按点击位置/次数区分。
5. **没有设置页**：大小用右键循环（110 / 138 / 190 / 260），位置拖拽即可（都持久化）。
6. **只在桌面窗里存在**：Electron 首次需下载约 100 MB。**没有页面内嵌版本** ——
   如果 Electron 起不来（下载失败、极端受限环境），就看不到照照，但 DSH 本身不受影响。

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cook-pet)
[](LICENSE)

> A little chef-girl desktop pet living inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/).
> Her name is **Zhaozhao** (照照). When idle she stands around holding a spatula; give her work and she
> **tosses a wok**; when a turn finishes she **brings you a plate of food**; when she
> **needs your approval or an answer, she props her chin on her hand and waits**; poke her and
> she'll wink or spin.

dsh-cook-pet README · Zhaozhao · dsh-cook-pet 🍳：**Four states (animated — these are the actual on-screen motions):**

| Idle | Cooking | Serving | Waiting |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
|  |  |  |  |
| stands and sways | tosses the wok | brings a plate | tilts her head, waits |

---

dsh-cook-pet README · ✨ What she does：| Moment | State | Visual | Text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| No task running | **idle** | stands, spatula in hand | — |
| Turn running (`turn/start`) | **cooking** | tosses the wok | — |
| **Waiting for your approval / answer** | **waiting** | chin on hand, head tilted | **"等你回话"** |
| Turn completed successfully | **serving** | brings a plate, auto-idles after ~5 s | — |
| Turn aborted / errored | quietly idle | **no celebration** | — |
| You click her | **wink or spin** | random pick, then back to current state | — |

dsh-cook-pet README · ✨ What she does：> **Only the "waiting" state shows text.** Everything else is pure animation — a desktop pet
> shouldn't have words covering the screen; only "it's your turn" deserves a glance.
>
> One more deliberate rule: **"serving" only appears when the task genuinely succeeded.**
> Interrupted, errored, timed out — she quietly returns to idle. She never gives you a fake
> "done" signal.

dsh-cook-pet README · 🤔 What "waiting" actually means：It is not a vague "busy" state. It maps to exactly **two kinds of real waiting**:

| Trigger | Host event |
| --- | --- |
| Permission dialog (a tool needs allow/deny) | `approval/asked` → `approval/decided` |
| Model asks you via `ask_user_question` | `tool/call` → `tool/result` |
| Plan mode hands a plan over for approval (`exit_plan_mode`) | same as above |
| Questions raised inside `run_code` scripts | `tool/ptc-dispatch-start` → `tool/ptc-dispatch` |

dsh-cook-pet README · 🤔 What "waiting" actually means：These are **paired, durable events**, so both "started waiting" and "you answered" are captured
precisely — no polling, no guessing, and closing the dialog outright cannot leave her stuck
in the waiting state.

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 How she was made：The character and all six animation clips are **AI-generated** (Q-style anime, green-screen /
black-background sources), then converted into **transparent video** by a reproducible asset pipeline.

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 How she was made：| Step | Technique | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Derive alpha | treat only *pure black connected to the frame border* as background | the black spatula and dark-brown outlines survive |
| 2. Edge colour extension | smear interior colours across the feathered band | otherwise the black background inside the feathered band becomes a dirty dark fringe |
| 3. Shared crop box | one box for all six clips (union) | the character must not jump when the action changes |
| 4. Encode | premultiplied alpha → VP9 `yuva420p` | the only transparent video format browsers handle reliably |

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 How she was made：> The most important lesson: **mp4/H.264 has no alpha channel.** A "cut-out mp4" merely has a
> black or green background baked in — the transparency simply isn't in the file. It must be
> re-encoded as `yuva420p` WebM.

The pipeline's pitfalls (all backed by measurements and regression tests) are documented in
[docs/素材管线实测.md](docs/素材管线实测.md) (Chinese).

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 Want your own character?：| Background | Consequence |
| --- | --- |
| **Pure green `#00FF00`** ⭐ | Easiest to key: green is far from the character's colours, so the matte is clean and **semi-transparent effects (smoke, glow) survive** |
| Pure black | Works, but **flattens translucent content** — white semi-transparent smoke becomes opaque dark grey and has to be reverse-engineered |
| White / grey / gradient | Hard to key; tends to eat the character's pale parts (white hat, white apron) |

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 Want your own character?：Also put these in the generation prompt: **fixed frontal camera**, **no positional drift**,
**identical first and last frame** (so loops don't jump), **no text or watermark**.
The full prompts for this project's six clips are in
[docs/视频提示词-等待确认.md](docs/视频提示词-等待确认.md) and
[docs/视频提示词-点击回应.md](docs/视频提示词-点击回应.md).

**Step 1: prepare the files**

Name six clips by *what they mean*, and drop them into `assets/cook-已抠图/`:

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 Want your own character?：| File | Played when | Requirement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `待机.mp4` | no task running | first/last pose identical, loopable |
| `颠锅.mp4` | a turn is running | same |
| `上菜.mp4` | a turn succeeded | plays once |
| `托腮.mp4` | waiting for your approval/answer | first/last pose identical, long-loopable |
| `wink.mp4` | click reply | first/last pose = the idle pose |

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 Want your own character?：> You can also feed it a **per-frame cut-out PNG sequence** (true alpha), like this project's
> final wok and serving clips — best quality, no inference needed. See the read branch in
> `scripts/build-assets.py`.

**Step 2: run the pipeline and verify**

```bash
npm run assets        # writes six transparent WebM files into assets/pet/
npm run assets:check  # verifies: transparent corners / dark regions kept / identical size / channel order
```

dsh-cook-pet README · 🎨 Want your own character?：**Step 3: the only two places to touch when the framing changes**

| What you changed | Also update |
| --- | --- |
| The crop box (`CROP` at the top of the script) | the hit-box ratio constants at the top of `runtime/electron-helper/renderer.js` |
| The asset content | `ASSET_VERSION` in `renderer.js` (+1, otherwise the desktop window may load a stale file) |

**Step 4: restart DSH**

The desktop window reads assets into memory at startup, so a restart is required for a full swap.

dsh-cook-pet README · ⚠️ Known limitations：1. **Part of the alpha is inferred**: the sources have no alpha channel. Four clips derive it from a
   black/green background; the wok and serving clips use per-frame cut-out PNG sequences (true alpha).
2. **The serving clip is 30 fps but had 5 frames deleted** (4.73 s → 4.57 s), so a one-frame hiccup is
   theoretically possible.
3. **Asset changes need a restart**: `?v=` busts the cache, but the desktop window reads assets into
   memory at startup.
4. **Click replies are a random 1-of-2**, not position/count based.
5. **No settings page**: size cycles on right-click (110 / 138 / 190 / 260), position by dragging
   (both persisted).
6. **She exists only in the desktop window**: Electron needs a ~100 MB one-time download.
   **There is no in-page version** — if Electron can't start (download blocked, heavily restricted
   environment) you won't see her, but DSH itself is unaffected.
